message:
We’ve all been there—suddenly needing our phones or tech to navigate a situation, only to find them out of battery or malfunctioning. That’s why it’s so important to have a reliable plan in place for our vehicles. Understanding basic emergency preparedness can make a world of difference when the unexpected happens. 🚗

Check out the helpful resources available that guide us on what to keep in our cars and how to stay safe on the road. What’s your go-to tip for keeping your vehicle ready for anything? We’d love to hear your thoughts!
